responseText:
You need to get to Hammer Rest. 

Seek Commander Gretta Ironhand in the heart of Gritstone Overwatch. She knows the tunnels well and can guide you. But first report to Captain Stoneblade of the Hammer Guard. He will see you off.

Keep a keen eye on the statues, and defend yourself should any of them shift a pebble.
name: ANV_FTUE_Dunir_GatewatcherStonebeard_12_Response
